name: Homemade Tomato Soup
directions: Chop the onion and garlic and roughly chop the tomatoes. Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat and sauté the onion for 5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute. Add the tomatoes, vegetable broth, and salt; bring to a boil, then simmer 20 minutes. Add the basil and blend with an immersion blender until smooth. Taste, adjust seasoning, and serve hot.
